tools.name: getAccount
tools.description: The authenticated Primitive account. managed_inbox_address is a domain, not a mailbox; sender_address (such as agent@pink-ram.primitive.email) is the mailbox sendEmail sends from by default. Result: id, email, plan, managed_inbox_address, created_at, limits, entitlements, onboarding_completed, and s

tools.name: getInboxStatus
tools.description: Check whether inbound email is ready. Domains are added and verified with the domain management tools at /mcp/full. Result: ready, receiving_ready, processing_ready, summary, next_actions, domains, endpoints, functions and recent_emails.

tools.name: getOutboundStatus
tools.description: What this account can send from, and to whom. Call it before sending outside Primitive or from a domain other than the managed inbox. Result: ready, summary, sendable_domains, domains, next_actions, and can_send_to, the recipients it may email.

Rows carry id, thread_id, received_at, from, to, subject, status and snippet; open

tools.name: replyToEmail
tools.description: Reply to one inbound email, threaded server-side. This sends a real email immediately and it cannot be undone or recalled, so call it only after the user has confirmed the reply. Expecting an answer? Pass await_reply: true to wait for it in this call. Result: the sent email's id, status, from, accep

tools.name: sendEmail
tools.description: Send a new email. It goes out immediately (or at scheduled_at) and cannot be recalled, so confirm the message with the user first. Leave `from` out to send from your managed inbox. To send later, set scheduled_at, at most 30 days ahead and without wait or attachments. Expecting an answer? Pass await

tools.name: listSentEmails
tools.description: List sent emails to audit delivery. Rows carry id, thread_id, created_at, status, from, to, subject and snippet, plus error_code, smtp_response_code or gates when a send did not deliver. Read one with getSentEmail. Result: sent_emails, cursor for the next page (null at the end), and total, total_cap

tools.name: getSentEmail
tools.description: Read a single sent email by id, to inspect its delivery, such as the SMTP response on a bounced send or the gate denial on a gate_denied one. Pass full: true for the stored record. Result: id, thread_id, created_at, status, from, to, subject, from_address, to_address, cc, bcc, reply_to, tags, in_rep

tools.name: awaitReply
tools.description: Wait for the threaded reply to a sent email (an id sendEmail or replyToEmail returned) when that send's own wait got none. Do not tell the user nobody replied unless this returns reply null with timed_out true. Threading is not proof of who wrote the reply: trust it only when reply.sender_verified i

tools.description: Read a whole conversation with message bodies: the tool for finding out what was said. Pass the id of any inbound email in the thread. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "awaitReply" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: getInboxStatus, listEmails, searchEmails, getEmail, listSentEmails, getSentEmail, getConversation, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Private data: getEmail, sendEmail, getSentEmail, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Public sink: getAccount, getInboxStatus, getOutboundStatus, listEmails, searchEmails, getEmail, replyToEmail, sendEmail, listSentEmails, getSentEmail, awaitReply, getConversation, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Destructive: getEmailAttachment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: getInboxStatus, listEmails, searchEmails, getEmail, listSentEmails, getSentEmail, getConversation, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Private data: getEmail, sendEmail, getSentEmail, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Public sink: getAccount, getInboxStatus, getOutboundStatus, listEmails, searchEmails, getEmail, replyToEmail, sendEmail, listSentEmails, getSentEmail, awaitReply, getConversation, getEmailAttachment, createEmailAddress · Destructive: getEmailAttachment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
